test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ROBOT' is written as 'BOTOR' and 'BRING' is written as 'INGRB'. How will 'PANTS' be written in that language?
solution:
**Explanation:**

According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 **First alphabet is placed at fifth place.**

 **Second** alphabet is placed at fourth place.

 Third alphabet is placed at first place.

 Fourth alphabet is placed at second place.

 Fifth alphabet is placed at third place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/766cfc031f767d8330baf322c13f9940a04dc9e5e6010656c986056f39d6ebde.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76dc209228aa5bf9ad938b7d674987e4e32c937b6b8cd85c20e59b9d2534c492.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12b510cc535cf1f4da8e29642607535cdf61f01140cb55fb0cc92c10f5dd98a8.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3.**
